segments.comment: Blocked B24 caller attempt: an independently selected Archeologist uses the starting pick-axe to dig down on a wished altar. C rejects the altar first in dig.c:dig_check(BY_YOU,...) with DIGCHECK_FAIL_ALTAR, so digcheck_fail_message() returns before dig.c:dig’s later altar_wrath() call. Keep this input-only probe as a source-named blocker; it is not a matching altar_wrath witness.
